_readme: The deliberately-breaking fixture's AFTER side (memql#5389, Step 7). baseline.json with exactly four changes:
PARSE    -- @serverOnly is gone from `annotations`, and reserved.json beside it does NOT reserve it.
MEANING  -- @cache still exists and its argument form narrowed from a bare number to a keyword set.
WIRE     -- folderCard projects `title` where it projected `name`; nothing refuses to load and every client reading the old key gets an absent value.
RESERVED -- @scopes is gone AND reserved, so it must produce NO finding. Without that arm the fixture would prove the classifier reports things, not that the ledger is read.
